name: Club Salad
description: A layered salad featuring romaine lettuce, bacon, eggs, cheese, chicken, carrots, and tomatoes, topped with ranch dressing or dip.
recipeIngredient: ¾ cup ranch or dip dressing
¾ cup grated cheese (marble, cheddar, etc.)

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all ingredients in a large bowl, layering each ingredient to look festive.

keywords: layered salad, club salad, ranch dressing

_similar.name: Bacon Broccoli Salad
_similar.description: A hearty broccoli salad with crispy bacon, red onion, and a tangy dressing featuring low-fat yogurt and feta cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine the broccoli, red onion, sunflower seeds, raisins, and crumbled bacon in a large salad bowl.
In a separate bowl, mix together the yogurt, mayonnaise, sugar, and lemon juice to make the dressing.
Pour the dressing over the salad ingredients and toss to coat.
Refrigerate for 2 hours to allow the flavors to meld.

_similar.keywords: broccoli salad, bacon salad, yogurt dressing

_similar.name: Pasta Salad
_similar.description: A colorful pasta salad with penne or spiral pasta, vegetables, feta cheese, and a tangy herb dressing.
recipeIngredient: ½ bag penne or spiral pasta

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the pasta according to package instructions, then drain and cool.
Add chopped green pepper, tomatoes, green onions, and sliced black olives to the cooled pasta.
Crumble the feta cheese into the pasta mixture.
Pour the Classic Herb dressing over the salad and toss to combine.

_similar.keywords: pasta salad, feta cheese, herb dressing, vegetable salad

_similar.name: Caribbean Chicken Salad
_similar.description: A refreshing salad featuring chicken, mango, pineapple, and Minute Rice, all tossed in Italian dressing.
recipeIngredient: 1 small can pineapple, diced and drained

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the Minute Rice in chicken broth according to package instructions.
Cook the chicken breast meat in a little oil until fully cooked.
Combine the cooked rice, chicken, and remaining ingredients in a large bowl.
Chill until served. Optional: add other fruits like grapes, mandarins, or plums for variation.

_similar.keywords: Caribbean chicken salad, fruit and rice salad, Italian dressing

_similar.name: Strawberry Tossed Salad
_similar.description: A fresh and fruity salad with mixed greens, strawberries, and a sweet vinaigrette.
recipeIngredient: 4 cups torn Bibb or Boston lettuce
1 cup (4 oz) shredded Monterey Jack cheese
½ cup slivered almonds, toasted or coated with sugar
¼ cup cider or red wine vinegar

recipeInstructions.text: Combine the first 7 ingredients (oil, sugar, vinegar, garlic, salt, paprika, and white pepper) in a jar with a tight-fitting lid and shake well to make the dressing.
Just before serving, toss salad greens, strawberries, cheese, and almonds in a large salad bowl.
Drizzle with the prepared dressing and toss to coat.

_similar.keywords: strawberry salad, fruit salad, sweet salad dressing

_similar.name: Caesar Dressin' Salad
_similar.description: A homemade Caesar salad dressing made with egg yolks, garlic, lemon juice, and Parmesan cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Put all ingredients in a blender or food processor and blend for 2 minutes.
Can be kept in the fridge for up to 2 weeks.
